data.name: Jignasa
data.long_meaning: The name Jignasa is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jñāna’, meaning knowledge. Jignasa signifies a person with an insatiable thirst for knowledge and understanding. It embodies the spirit of inquiry and curiosity, reflecting the desire to explore the depths of life and unravel its mysteries.

Individuals with this name are likely to be associated with academic excellence, intellectual curiosity, and a strong inclination towards learning and exploration.

This name serves as a reminder to continually inquire, learn, and grow, both materially and spiritually.
